description: Physical ArUco sticker layout on the warehouse carts. The cart and all shelves are built EXACTLY to the drawing (confirmed 100 % by the operator): width, depth, top-plate height and every shelf height are exact values, not estimates.
codeMmNote: codeMm is the black square code incl. its black outer border bit (the 4x4 data bits + 1-bit black frame = 6x6 cells of 15 mm).
stickerMounting: every sticker lies flat, face up, horizontal, on a horizontal surface (the top plate or a shelf surface). In-plane rotation of each sticker is NOT specified (may be glued rotated by 90/180/270 deg).
cartFrame: origin at the TOP front-left corner of the cart; X along the 1600 mm front (0..1600), Y into the cart (0 = front edge, 450 = back), Z up, Z = 0 at the top plate, negative downwards.

cart.note: EXACT dimensions (cart built to the drawing, confirmed). Shelf sticker Z = -(heightAboveFloorMm_topPlate - shelfSurfaceHeightAboveFloorMm[row]). Rows D and E carry no stickers.

sharedIdsNote: ids 0-8 are the same on every cart; only the unique id tells the carts apart.
stickerPlacementCertainty: 100 % certain: every sticker is glued exactly at its described position on its described surface (confirmed by the operator). Do not assume or fit sticker placement errors. Only the in-plane rotation of a sticker is unspecified.
